fixed-desktop-panel-widths.why: Grid uses minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.15fr); no fixed px panel widths.

page-level-horizontal-scroll.why: Playwright: documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth was false at 1440px and 390px.

secondary-panels-dominating-primary-task.why: Primary task is finding a UI; the list and search come first and the detail panel only fills with a selection (overview otherwise).

no-control-overlap.why: Screenshots at 1440px and 390px inspected: search, filter chips and toggle wrap without overlap.

no-page-level-horizontal-overflow.why: Same Playwright scrollWidth check at both widths returned false; long paths use overflow-wrap:anywhere.

keyboard-reachable-controls.why: All rows, chips and actions are buttons; '/' focuses search, ArrowUp/Down moves selection (Playwright ArrowDown changed the selected row), Escape closes the phone detail.

persistent-selection-visible.why: Selected row keeps aria-selected highlight with a left bar, its project header is highlighted, and the selection is kept in the URL hash.

balanced-panel-sizing.why: Desktop screenshot: list and detail at roughly 46/54 split, both sticky with their own scroll.

clear-primary-action.why: Detail puts 'How to open it' with a Copy button, or an 'Open this page' button for single-file pages, directly under the status.

details-do-not-obscure-context.why: Desktop: detail sits beside the list. Phone (<=860px): detail replaces the list full-screen by design, with a Back control that restores focus to the selected row (Playwright: back hid the detail).

first-frame-legibility.why: The owner's own reading of the first screen is the real check; it has not happened yet.
